artifact.gitCommitPolicy: The PDF must never be added to the repository. Only its hash, bibliographic identity, and short anchor excerpts are tracked here.

provenance.origin: Uploaded by the project owner to the production application on 2026-07-18; copied byte-for-byte to the private eval bucket on 2026-07-19 before the production purge.

provenance.accessControl: The application only ever addresses SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=documents. The anon key returns HTTP 400 on a direct object read of this bucket and an empty list under RLS. No ordinary application user can reach it.
provenance.purpose: Private, non-redistributed evaluation of the project's own extraction, research, and edition-generation pipeline.
provenance.redistribution: None. The fixture is never served to users, never included in a deployment artifact, and never committed.
